title: Rust Debug-Session Plan
description: A structured plan naming the chosen debugging tool and knobs for a Rust bug, so the tool-to-bug-shape match and this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/debug_plan_audit.mjs.

symptom.description: The observed bug shape, per this skill's Decision Points flowchart.

isAsync.description: Whether the code path in question runs on an async executor (tokio/smol/async-std).

chosenTool.description: The tool selected for this debug session, e.g. 'tokio-console', 'rust-lldb', 'miri', 'flamegraph', 'otool'.

tracingSpanGuardAcrossAwait.description: True if a tracing span.enter()/entered() guard is held across an .await point in the async code under investigation.

tokioConsoleFlagsSet.description: True if RUSTFLAGS="--cfg tokio_unstable" and tokio's "tracing" feature are both set for this session.

releaseDebugSymbols.description: True if [profile.release] debug = true is set so a release-build profile resolves real symbol names.

genericBreakpointRegex.description: True if lldb/gdb breakpoints on generic functions use a regex (breakpoint set -r / rbreak) rather than a bare symbol.

stackOverflowKnob.description: Which stack-overflow knob this plan intends to use: RUST_MIN_STACK (runtime thread stack size) or recursion_limit (compile-time recursion cap).

dlopenGuarded.description: True if every dlopen/Library::new on a process-critical path is probed (e.g. RTLD_NOLOAD) and degrades the feature on failure, rather than aborting the process.

reproducedUnderMiriOrSanitizer.description: True if a heisenbug or suspected UB has been reproduced deterministically under Miri or a sanitizer, rather than 'fixed' by adding a print/log.
